card.text: Small moon that leads Tethys along its orbit around Saturn.

introduction.text: Telesto has a smooth, icy surface without the heavy cratering seen on many of Saturn's moons.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness matching reduces shading; terrain in cast shadows is left empty.

false-color.title: Cassini false color
false-color.summary: False color from three filters taken minutes apart, so changing light also affects hue.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 12.35 km sphere from the Cassini shape; small craters are not resolved.
